annotations.title: Domain registration data (RDAP/WHOIS): registrar, created, expires, age, status

description: Domain registration data (RDAP/WHOIS): registrar, created, expires, age, status. Looks up the registry RDAP server for the TLD (IANA bootstrap) and returns the registrar, registration / expiry / last-changed dates, domain age in days, days until expiry, EPP status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC delegation. Useful for fraud and phishing checks (young domains). Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
